relative_mount_pose.pitch_derivation: The config exposes offset.rot (quaternion), not an Euler pitch field. In the ROS convention (+Z forward, -Y up), (-0.5, 0.5, -0.5, 0.5) maps optical +Z to parent +X with zero elevation/pitch; convention and axis definitions are documented in IsaacLab camera_cfg.py lines 27-35 and camera_data.py lines 72-80.

fov.derivation: 2*atan(pixel_extent/(2*focal_pixels)); manifest K has fx=fy=227.55555725097656 and 512 px extent, giving 96.7329209 degrees in both axes. The config does not explicitly set vertical_aperture.

on_disk_rgb.method: PIL-decode every JPEG, convert to RGB, then inspect numpy shape and dtype
on_disk_rgb.note: JPEG files are compressed on disk; uint8 refers to the decoded RGB array required by the observation contract.

geometric_horizon_y_px_at_center_x_256.definition: Projection of the world-horizontal ray plane using saved ROS camera quaternion; indoor RGB may not contain a visible semantic horizon line.
